existing_overlap: No existing published article defines AGI; ai-glossary-50-terms has no AGI entry. Neighbouring concepts are linked, not repeated: ai-term-artificial-intelligence, ai-term-benchmark, ai-term-ai-alignment, ai-hype-vs-reality-2026, ai-terms-index.
notes: Definitions are attributed to whoever wrote them; the article asserts no universal definition and makes no prediction of when AGI arrives. No model names, prices or leaderboard scores. The headline example (a 90 percent question-bank score) is a labelled hypothetical, not an observation. Contract material is reduced to one durable sentence: AGI has been written into a partnership agreement between companies, and the companies' official announcements give no criteria for judging it; no company names, dates or terms are given, and the 2026 amendment is read but not cited. Morris et al. was read in arXiv v5 (2025-09-24), where Level 4 is named Exceptional, and in the ICML/PMLR version, where it is Virtuoso; the article notes both. openai.com pages return 403 to curl and WebFetch and were read through Wayback snapshots; sources list the original URLs. Second-round fact check on 2026-10-03.

consulted_not_cited.note: 2026-04-27 amended agreement; no mention of AGI or the expert panel. Read to word the checklist sentence in the past tense; not cited because the article no longer describes contract terms.
